# Amethyst

Amethyst applies a purple color scheme to the Obsidian interface. It works in both dark and light mode and keeps accents and typography consistent across the interface.

![Amethyst screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cotemaxime/obsidian-amethyst/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Amethyst"
    author: "cotemaxime"
    repo:   "cotemaxime/obsidian-amethyst"
    slug:   "amethyst"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/amethyst"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/cotemaxime/obsidian-amethyst"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cotemaxime/obsidian-amethyst/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes:  ["dark", "light"]
    legacy: true
    about:  "Apply a purple amethyst color scheme to Obsidian, compatible with both dark and light modes. Style the interface with cohesive purple accents and consistent typography for a unified, readable look."
}
```
